description: This file is an HTML source for a database visualization web application, including embedded CSS and JavaScript for UI rendering, data fetching, and interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading the available databases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell contents, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
